step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a data migration and real-time synchronization architecture from an on-premise legacy database (IBM DB2) into AWS. Two distinct pipelines are illustrated: 1) Initial batch loading: IBM DB2 connects to AWS DMS, which loads data into Amazon S3, followed by ETL processing via Amazon EMR, writing out to DynamoDB and Elasticsearch (OpenSearch). 2) Real-time CDC synchronization: IBM DB2 streams changes to Amazon Kinesis, ingested by an AWS Lambda function that writes to DynamoDB; DynamoDB Streams trigger a second AWS Lambda function to update Elasticsearch (OpenSearch). An API box is shown at the top right.
